name: xyflow
description: React Flow | Svelte Flow - Powerful open source libraries for building node-based UIs with React (https://reactflow.dev) or Svelte (https://svelteflow.dev). Ready out-of-the-box and infinitely customizable.

issues.title: RFC - Spatial Queries & Virtualisation in XYFlow
Breaks when built using Vite 8 / rolldown
Be able to pan the viewport on right mouse click on Node.
useKeyPress doesn't track repeated combination keypresses until the entire combination is released
Improve viewport restrictions via translateExtent & maxZoom, minZoom
pathOptions borderRadius does not work correctly when connecting two vertically aligned nodes
Modifying the node order via setNodes does not take effect

discussions.title: Breatic: a collaborative AI creation canvas built with React Flow and Yjs
OpenMontage Drama Studio: React Flow canvas for an AI short-drama pipeline (shots, stages, subgraphs)
Replay example for stale node changes after removal
GFT Map: reviewing AI conversation decisions with React Flow v11
Lianjing (连镜) – open-source AI image/video creation canvas built on React Flow
SkillTangram: a React Flow canvas for composing AI Skills, with nested module editing
Built-in annotation node type with data attributes for text styling (font, size, color, outline, bold, italic, underline, highlight, link, list, alignment)
Conflicting guidance on hideAttribution and Pro subscription requirement

latest_release.name: @xyflow/svelte@1.7.1
latest_release.body:
### Patch Changes

-   [#6106](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow/pull/6106) [`b65d451`](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow/commit/b65d451fdb2dc0039de30024b93044e1a38070c0) - Prevent excessive repainting of nodes during pan & zoom


-   [#6068](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow/pull/6068) [`7813eeb`](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow/commit/7813eebf06ca22dadbeb7bb919ff8cd8388adcab) - Cancel a pending click connection when clicking the pane and call `onClickConnectEnd` / `onclickconnectend`


-   [#6090](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow/pull/6090) [`b235ea0`](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow/commit/b235ea03677fa500b9474aedf0bdd35abaf76b78) - Respect `nodeOrigin` in `isNodeIntersecting` and `getIntersectingNodes` when you pass a node object instead of `{ id }`


-   [#6054](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow/pull/6054) [`c7d0fcb`](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow/commit/c7d0fcb3372e234c33d2c87bec8d4c8394abab74) - Disconnect the `ResizeObserver`s when a flow unmounts
